item.title: FG Secures Funding for 90,000km Fibre Optic Network, Plans Two New Communication Satellites — Tijani
item.description: Bosun Tijani, minister of communications, innovation and digital economy, says the federal government has secured the funds required to deploy 90,000 kilometres of fibre optic infrastructure across Nigeria. Tijani spoke on Wednesday in Abuja at an event marking the Global Privacy Day, organised by the Nigerian Data Protection Commission (NDPC), disclosing the government’s plan to buy two satellites. item.title: There’s no such thing as an independent woman -Mary Njoku
item.description: Mary Njoku, the Nollywood actress and filmmaker, says there is really no such thing as an “independent woman”. In a recent post shared on her Instagram page, the actress argued that independence in women is often a response to the absence of reliable support, not a personal choice. item.title: EPL table: Arsenal re-restablish 7-point gap with 4-0 win at Leeds
item.description: Arsenal shook off their 3-2 defeat to Manchester United last week, with an emphatic 4-0 win at Leeds United on Saturday. The Gunners had seen their lead at the top cut to four points following that result. item.title: 93% of Nigerians use AI tools well above global average — Google
item.description: Google says Nigerians are not just embracing artificial intelligence (AI) but are leading the charge globally. In its report on Tuesday, titled “Our Life with AI: Helpfulness in the Hands of More People,” Google said Nigerians are using AI tools for everything from education to entrepreneurship, showing immense optimism for the technology’s future. item.title: APC formally welcomes Agbu Kefas as its 30th governor
item.description: Agbu Kefas, governor of Taraba state, has formally joined the All Progressives Congress (APC), increasing the number of APC governors to 30. The APC had earlier postponed the planned reception for Kefas in honour of members of the armed forces and citizens recently killed in attacks by terrorists in November 2025. item.title: ‘I’ve been pushed to the wall’ — Nwifuru sacks commissioners, traditional rulers over Ebonyi killings
item.description: Francis Nwifuru, governor of Ebonyi, has dissolved the political and traditional leadership structures of the Amasiri clan in Afikpo LGA following the killing of three persons over a communal land dispute. Nwifuru sacked the officials on Sunday during a visit to Okporojo village in the Oso Edda community, where the victims were reportedly beheaded, and another died from injuries sustained during the attack.
